description: MegaCam is the wide-field CCD imager used at the MMT and at Magellan. This set is the Magellan Sloan u'g'r'i'z' filter set, not the earlier MMT filters and not the CFHT MegaCam.
facility_description: This MegaCam is the wide-field CCD imager McLeod et al. 2015 describe for the MMT and the Magellan telescopes at Las Campanas Observatory.
notes: The filter page says the Magellan filters are Sloan bandpasses and keeps a separate table for the MMT-era MegaCam filters. Fukugita et al. 1996 is the SDSS photometric-system paper; the measured curves are the CFA tables. The page does not state Vega or AB. McLeod et al. 2015, PASP 127, 366 is the instrument paper. Narrow-band filters listed on the same page are not in this NJM instrument.

u.Comments: The CFA filter page calls these the Magellan Sloan bandpass filters and links a filter-only table and a total-throughput table. Total throughput on that page includes CCD QE, primary and secondary reflectivity, corrector and window transmission, and the atmosphere at 1.2 airmasses.
